Help & Support

Find answers to common questions about Campus Food Services.

01

How do I raise a request?

Select "Raise Request" from the student menu, complete the complaint form and submit it.

02

How do I track my request?

Open "My Requests" to view your submitted complaints and their current status.

03

When can I provide feedback?

Feedback becomes available after an eligible complaint has been resolved.

04

Need additional help?

Contact the campus food services administration team for assistance.
